_comment: Release profiles for the desktop build. Select one with BIBLE_RELEASE_PROFILE (the Release workflow sets 'base'); with none set the build is 'full' (everything on). 'disabledModules' are feature-module ids removed from both the renderer and main-process hosts; 'extensions: false' removes the extension host, marketplace and Preferences > Extensions. To re-enable a feature in a later release, delete its id here.
